subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 32, September 23rd, 2026, Two scopes, one page
body:
Two scopes, one page

Carousel No. 32, September 23rd, 2026

Held at 5.95 against 8.0. Read before posting.

This run did not merge, so the images below come from the run branch claude/daily-2026-09-23 rather than from main. They stop resolving if that branch is deleted.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Two scopes, one page, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

About 474 gigawatts is the whole queue.

The state puts data centers at about 90 percent of new requests. Two different denominators.

On September 21st the Governor told TCEQ to issue no permits sought by data centers and to use what the audits find. The August 3rd audit covers data centers advancing through ERCOT's interconnection process.

A West Texas data center contracted 76 megawatts behind the meter from about 40 gas engines. The audit reads a process that supply never enters. Read the directive by who is asking and it reaches the project. Read it by the audit and 76 megawatts vanish.

A separate water directive makes a missed survey a bar to TCEQ permits under Chapter 11 of the Texas Water Code. That test is not the queue either.

TCEQ reports on compliance by October 19th. It canceled a Bexar County hearing and set no date. Compliance with which scope?

#TCEQ #ERCOT #WestTexas

Notes

THE RECORD SHIPPED. THE DECK DID NOT. NOTHING HERE IS TO BE POSTED TODAY. shipped_check's completion gate refuses this deck and it is right. 5.95 is under 7.01, which is what the last ten shipped decks have actually been holding, and that floor is measured off shipped work rather than set in a config. The five round cap ends the SEARCH and it does not end the STANDARD. Per the delivery policy a failed run commits its evidence and does not merge, so the branch claude/daily-2026-09-23 carries everything and main is untouched. THE ONE THING WORTH YOUR ATTENTION TODAY. The record work on that branch is sound, it passes every gate, and it includes the fix that stops three Hays County items reporting as ROTTEN. CI exits 1 on a rotten item, so until that branch is merged or the work is redone, every pull request against main is red on a gate whose remedy no run can take. Those three items sit on public.destinyhosted.com, which serves Disallow slash to every client, and on www.hayscountytx.gov, which answers 403 to both fetchers this routine has. There is no second door and nothing was routed around. WHAT THE RECORD DID TODAY. 157 items, 94 re-verified, tx-2026-0182 admitted. The docket now distinguishes UNREACHABLE from UNCHECKED. An item declares the hosts, the boundary and the date it was measured, the block must cover the item's own front door, and it lapses in seven days, so the carve-out is a standing obligation to re-measure rather than a note that silences a gate once. WHY THE DECK FELL SHORT, IN ONE LINE. Craft, and specifically the cover. Frame 1's machines, pad and right edge slab measure as one connected bright mass holding 0.86 of every pixel over lightness 30. Two repairs were tried and measured. A deeper contact left it at 0.86 and pushed the frame median under its own declared floor, and darkening the pad is what that frame already did and had to take back. Figure and ground are drawn in the same screen at the same angle and pitch, so no value move separates one material from itself. The cure is a different mark and it is written into the upgrade backlog rather than guessed at. TWO HARD FAILS WERE FOUND BY SCORERS AND REPAIRED, AND BOTH WERE THE SAME DEFECT. A refuted sentence was repaired on the frame a judge quoted while the same proposition survived in the published web edition, twice, in two different wordings. A caption length budget spent a scope limiter from c22. Neither is live now and scores/hard_fail_repairs.json records both, with how each repair was checked. THREE OTHER FILES WERE ASSERTING THINGS NOBODY HAD MEASURED. Every citation line in the first comment carried the FETCH date, so the August 3rd audit release read as published September 23rd under a deck whose own frame 7 says otherwise. Frame 4's load bearing label used three literal spaces that HTML collapses, so it rendered as one run-on. And three luminance figures in the storyboard were typed rather than composed, two of them stale by the time the art stopped moving. All three are fixed, each with a self-test or a writer that cannot go quiet. Nothing was sent. These routines draft only.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck did NOT merge, so nothing here is on main and there is nothing to post. The links resolve against the run branch for as long as it exists.
